fix_subject: Validate TIME range when decoding binary Variant values and harden FormatTwoDigits

labels.summary: Decoding a binary VARIANT TIME_NTZ_MICROS value accepted any 64-bit integer instead of rejecting values outside [0, MICROS_PER_DAY], so corrupted or malicious input passed silently; the commit adds a range check that throws IOException, and turns the debug-only assert in FormatTwoDigits into a thrown InternalException.
